title: Delivery Claims Policy Manual, Section 1: Opening a Claim
content:
**1.1** A Delivery Claims claim is opened only by the customer who placed the order, and only for the claim type that matches what the records show: a Lost in Transit Claim needs the order in status shipped; every other claim type needs the order in status delivered or closed.

**1.2** A claim is opened only for an order in status shipped, delivered or closed. An order in any other status carries no claim.

**1.3** Only one claim of each type that is not withdrawn may exist per order. A claim that is opened, in carrier trace, under review, approved, denied or resolved counts toward that limit; a withdrawn claim does not.

**1.4** A parcel misdelivered because of an address the customer entered wrongly, or returned from a pickup point because it was not collected, is not a claim: the order closes as returned to sender under the Online Orders rules.

**1.5** The customer never files anything with the carrier; Marlowe & Finch deals with the carrier.

**1.6** A defect that appears in use is a Quality Issue Return under Returns & Exchanges, not a Damaged in Transit Claim.

**1.7** The claimed value is measured as the net merchandise paid plus tax: over the whole order when the claim type covers the parcel, and over the claimed order lines when it covers lines.

## What decides each point

| Point | Decided by | Not decided by |
|---|---|---|
| Whose order it is | the customer recorded on the order | the caller's account of who ordered |
| Which claim type fits | the order's status in the records | the type the customer asks for |
| Whether the order can carry a claim at all | the order's status: shipped, delivered or closed | — |
| Whether a claim of that type already exists | the claims on that order, by type and status | — |

Every check is made against the order the claim is for, identified by its order number.

## Order status and claim type

| Order status | Lost in Transit Claim | Any other claim type |
|---|---|---|
| shipped | may be opened | not opened |
| delivered | not opened | may be opened |
| closed | not opened | may be opened |

## Points of judgement

- *Hypothetical:* an order still in status shipped cannot carry a Damaged in Transit Claim, whatever the customer reports about the box, because that type needs the order delivered or closed.
- *Hypothetical:* an order already carrying a withdrawn Missing Item Claim may receive a new Missing Item Claim, because the withdrawn claim does not count toward the limit of one per type.
- *Hypothetical:* an order carrying a denied Delivered Not Received Claim cannot receive a second Delivered Not Received Claim; a denied claim still counts.
